motion.name: flap-light-lifecycle
motion.purpose: Front shade peaks during departure; back shadow and highlight release as the new face arrives.

motion.purpose: Cylindrical wheel settles at the selected option.

motion.purpose: Flap animation and general transitions collapse while functions continue.

narrative.overview: GHR-01 is an enlarged split-flap timepiece exactly centered in the viewport over a selected mountain photograph. Source-derived FlipClok dark tiles, rounded monospaced digits, layered hinge seams, and restrained shadows sit within the established layout, mechanics, and settings system.
keyCharacteristics: Source-derived FlipClok #111315 app dark and #2D3134 tile styling.
Heavy ui-rounded/SF Pro Rounded monospaced digits in #EFEEE7.
Continuous tile radius of 9% height capped at 42px.
Layered hinge seam and restrained physical shadow.
Existing photo, layout, mechanics, settings, and responsive centering preserved.

rules.name: The Mechanism Is Honest Rule
rules.body: Cards retain 51%-clipped panels, 200%-height full glyphs, -100% lower offsets, pivots, paired 180-degree folds, and persistent shade overlays.

rules.name: The FlipClok Dark Rule
rules.body: Use exact source-derived dark values, rounded heavy monospaced digits, 9%-capped tile radius, layered hinge, and restrained shadow for time hardware.

dos: Keep the flip display viewport-centered regardless of controls.
Use exact FlipClok dark palette and rounded monospaced digit treatment.
Derive cards, glyphs, and colons from the inline-size query --card-width token.
Align both wheel selection lines to the display 50% hinge and put controls absolutely below.
Use anchored shortcut settings with conflict rejection and session-only fallback feedback.
donts: Do not use pill-tab or segmented navigation for modes.
Do not substitute earlier Barlow/Manrope or warm graphite tile styling for the FlipClok-derived system.
Do not introduce independent responsive sizing for card height, glyphs, or colons.
Do not execute shortcuts on repeated keys or within text-entry controls.
Do not crop, retype, or independently align lower glyph faces.
